reviewed_by: Codex focused review for bulk chat actions and compact toolbar
reason: The selected tests cover full-list selection and Core readback, partial failure and retry, archive and restore, pin and flag, deletion confirmation and durable removal, sidebar grouping, assistant destination discovery, product-help search and Chroma source-digest synchronization. The real-Core journey runs on the production bundle over a non-loopback LAN origin in desktop and emulated mobile Chromium and WebKit profiles. The same selected real-Core browser journey now checks that the selection toolbar fits in a compact two-row height without clipping while retaining 44 px controls across desktop and mobile profiles.
exclusions: No native code changed. Unrelated chat streaming, mission, provider, and project workflows are excluded. The existing single-chat and delete-all actions retain their API contracts. Physical-device testing is unavailable.
